description: Source code for the cave map generator component of the Wesnoth game, including map creation, chamber and passage placement, and terrain setting.

classes.name: cave_map_generator
classes.description: Class responsible for generating cave maps, including chambers and passages, with configurable parameters.

classes.name: passage_path_calculator
classes.description: A cost calculator used in pathfinding for passages, considering terrain and windiness.

methods.name: translate_x
methods.description: Translates x-coordinate based on flipx setting.

methods.name: translate_y
methods.description: Translates y-coordinate based on flipy setting.

methods.name: allow_user_config
methods.description: Indicates if user configuration is allowed.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the generator ('cave').

methods.name: create_map
methods.description: Creates a map based on provided arguments.

methods.name: create_scenario
methods.description: Generates the cave scenario including chambers and passages.

methods.name: build_chamber
methods.description: Recursively builds a chamber of specified size and jaggedness.

methods.name: place_chamber
methods.description: Places a chamber on the map.

methods.name: place_passage
methods.description: Creates a passage between locations using pathfinding.

methods.name: on_board
methods.description: Checks if a location is within map bounds.

methods.name: set_terrain
methods.description: Sets terrain at a location, possibly converting to village.

methods.name: place_castle
methods.description: Places a castle terrain at a location and its adjacent tiles.
